children-of-israel.name: The Children of Israel
children-of-israel.title: The Children of Israel
children-of-israel.dict: The people of Moses, addressed directly again and again ("O Children of Israel!"): reminded that God favored them over all peoples (2:47), delivered them from Pharaoh and gave them the Book, and charged with breaking their covenant, worshiping the calf and killing prophets. The Quran also says that among them is a community that guides by the truth (7:159).

christians.name: The Christians
christians.title: The Christians
christians.dict: Called Nasara. They are "nearest in affection towards the believers", because among them are priests and monks and they are not arrogant (5:82); compassion and mercy were put in the hearts of those who followed Jesus (57:27). They are told not to say "Three" (4:171), and the sayings that God is the Messiah, or the third of three, are called unbelief (5:72-73).

companions-of-the-cave.name: The Companions of the Cave
companions-of-the-cave.title: The Companions of the Cave
companions-of-the-cave.dict: Young men who take refuge in a cave from a people who worship other gods, and are put to sleep there "three hundred years, adding nine" (18:9-26). The Quran declines to say how many they were. The story is known among Christians as the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus.
